questions.questionText: What is the capital of Japan?
questions.explanation: Tokyo is the capital and most populous city of Japan.

questions.questionText: Rank the celestial bodies by size, from smallest to largest.
questions.explanation: The order of these bodies by size is Moon, Earth, and Sun.

questions.questionText: Select the three primary colors of light.
